messages:
Alex: Heads up — need SOC2 + pen-test summary templates for the upcoming SI integration listing. We need a tight package for the marketplace security reviewers. Key things: control mapping, redactions, evidence links, test window.
Mira: I can start a draft template. Uploading a sheet in drive: https://drive.redwood/team/compliance/soc-summary-draft
Samir: Timeline? marketplace listing wants proof by EOD next Wed.
Alex: Yep, deadline Wed EOD. Can we split owners?
Mira: I'll own SOC2 narrative + control mapping.
Samir: I'll own pen-test summary + scope/POC notes.
Jordan: I'll take artifact packaging (presigned S3 + encryption attestation). Do we include HSM attestation snippet?
Alex: Yes include HSM + KMS posture. @Jordan add example attestation text.
compliance-bot: Reminder: evidence retention TTL is 90 days for presigned links. Please use secure-share for longer.
Mira: Noted. Will include redaction checklist. quick snippet:
```
Redaction checklist:
- Remove dev credentials
- Mask user PII
- Version RFCs
```
Samir: For pen-test, do we need raw logs or summarized findings? vendor prefers summarized + raw on request.
Alex: Summarized findings in the bundle, raw logs via secure share + contact. Add contact owner to metadata.
Jordan: Question — marketplace asks for signed SOC cover page. Do we have a signed PDF?
Mira: Legal has one from last quarter, I'll attach.
Alex: Great. Owners: Mira (SOC narrative + cover PDF), Samir (pen-test summary), Jordan (artifact packaging + presign), Alex (coord + timeline). I'll do a quick handoff doc.
Mira: I'll drop the draft in the drive by EOD today.
Samir: Starting pen-test summary now, ping me if you need specific PoC blurs.
Jordan: Packaging notes — use s3://redwood-marketplace-artifacts/<partner>/<date>/; prefix with README.txt containing owners.
Alex: Nice. After docs are ready let's do a 30m split-review Thurs morning. @Mira @Samir @Jordan please add calendar slots.
Mira: added.
Samir: added.
Jordan: added. :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks all — will push a checklist update to the marketplace tracker.
